signals.text: 'Putting his doubters in their place' - Rooney lands pundit of year award. Former Manchester United and England captain Wayne Rooney is named pundit of the year at the prestigious Broadcast Sport Awards.
Everton's Grealish unavailable again after 'breach of discipline'. Jack Grealish remains unavailable for Everton's Premier League clash with Coventry on Friday, manager David Moyes confirms.

Good to feel club are committed to me - Jaissle. Newcastle United manager Matthias Jaissle says he has "got more of a feeling from within the club" about how "committed" they are to him amid his side's struggling form.

Owono left out of Eq Guinea squad after death of De Miguel. Goalkeeper Jesus Owono will miss Equatorial Guinea's Afcon 2027 qualifiers after asking to be left out of the squad following the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel.
